scope.summary: Ensemble is a macOS menu bar app, written in Swift, that drives Claude desktop sessions hands-free with a webcam; no data leaves the Mac.

not_applicable.pyproject, ruff, ty, uv, pytest, coverag: The repository has no Python. The equivalents are Package.swift, swift build -c release and swift test in ci.yml. Swift has no coverage gate here; the unit tests run on every pull request.
not_applicable.pip-audit scheduled workflow: Swift Package Manager dependencies (Sparkle only) are covered by the dependabot.yml swift entry.

optins.SPARKLE_ED_PRIVATE_KEY: Sparkle EdDSA key, an environment secret of the release environment used by auto-release.yml to sign the update feed entry so installed copies accept updates.
optins.TRAFFIC_TOKEN: Fine-grained token for clonometer.yml: reads the repository's traffic (clones and views need Administration: read, which the built-in token cannot hold) and writes the daily count to the badges branch (Contents: write). The website shows the clone total from that branch.
